en: We nicknamed the WARDEN\n“SLOWPOKE.”\pYou know, he has that vacant look\nlike a SLOWPOKE.
WARDEN SLOWPOKE is very\nknowledgeable about POKéMON.\pHe even has some fossils of rare,\nextinct POKéMON.
WARDEN SLOWPOKE came in, but\nI couldn't understand him.\pI think he's got a speech problem!

WARDEN SLOWPOKE is running a
promotion campaign right now.\pTry to get to the farthest corner
of the SAFARI ZONE.\pIf you can make it, you'll win a
very convenient prize.
